errors: The main agent supplied no structured output reporting the corresponding AI assertion results.

evidence: Artifacts 000012, 000014, and 000018 contain passed backend AI assertion results, confidence/provider metadata, and screenshot references. They report only reimbursable=no values across overlapping source views, including the file header and apparent bottom.
The supplied tool-call history records opening Pro Expense but no expense-entry or save actions.

Artifact 000029 shows Pro Expense entries including Reimbursements ($385.81) and Doctor Visits ($75.54), which match source rows marked no. No baseline establishes when those entries were created, so their presence does not prove this run logged excluded rows.
Execution step 1 reports that the agent exceeded its configured turn limit before producing structured verification output.
output.summary: The evidence does not conclusively establish the required final state. Backend AI assertions report no reimbursable=yes rows, and no expense-creation actions are recorded, but the run ended without structured verification output or a conclusive comparison of Pro Expense changes.
